summary: Dry day with a cold start: about 0–1 °C at Medinaceli and Daroca on the 07:00–09:50 leg, so watch for frost or fog patches, then 7–14 °C and brighter later. No closures, roadworks, strikes or events found that affect the A-2 or N-234 on 28 Nov.

items.title: Frost or fog patches possible before 10:00
items.detail: About 1 °C with humidity near 100% at Medinaceli around 08:15 and 0–3 °C near Daroca around 09:15. Drive gently on bridges and shaded bends, and leave Calatayud later if fog is lying; no AEMET warning found.

items.title: Bus-VAO lane on the A-2 toward Madrid
items.detail: The A-2 has a Bus-VAO (high-occupancy) lane between Alcalá and Madrid. Check the overhead signs for who may use it before moving into it on the way back to the airport.
